topic: Getting on the Waitlist for Brunch

script.title: ON THE WAITLIST
script.scene_zh: 早午餐店門口 · 排候位名單
script.story_hook: No table, no problem. Just get on the list.
script.intro_zh: 沒有位子也不妨礙。先排進候位名單就好。
script.welcome_en: Welcome! Today you'll hear a real brunch waitlist chat. You'll also learn to ask for a window seat.
script.welcome_zh: 歡迎！今天你會聽到一段真實的早午餐候位對話。你還會學會怎麼開口要靠窗座位。
script.outro: That's a wrap on today's brunch scene. Listen again and shadow your favorite lines.
script.outro_zh: 今天的早午餐對話就到這裡。再聽一遍，跟著唸你最愛的那幾句。
script.practice_intro_en: Time to repeat! Listen, then say each line out loud.
script.practice_intro_zh: 輪到跟讀了！先聽，再把每一句大聲唸出來。
script.char_a_description: a young man in his late twenties with short dark curly hair and a thin beard, wearing an olive green hoodie, blue jeans, and white sneakers, slim build, holding a phone with a friendly, slightly tired smile.
script.char_b_description: a cheerful woman around thirty with long straight black hair tucked behind one ear, wearing a gray blazer over a cream blouse, dark trousers, and a round name badge, medium build, holding a neat reservation tablet.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi! Do you have a table for two?
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ du jə həv ə ˈteɪbəl fɔr tu/
dialogue.zh: 嗨！請問有兩人的桌位嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hi! Did you make a reservation?
dialogue.zh: 你好！請問有預約嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Um, no. My friend is running late.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌm noʊ maɪ frɛnd ɪz ˈrʌnɪŋ leɪt/
dialogue.zh: 呃，沒有。我朋友還要晚一點才到。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Well, the wait is about forty-five minutes.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛl ðə weɪt ɪz əˈbaʊt ˈfɔrti faɪv ˈmɪnɪts/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，大約要等四十五分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's fine. Can we get on the list?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts faɪn kən wi ɡɛt ɑn ðə lɪst/
dialogue.zh: 沒關係。可以幫我們排進名單嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure! What name should I write?
dialogue.zh: 當然！請問要寫什麼名字？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Daniel. It's D-A-N-I-E-L.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈdæniəl ɪts di ˈeɪ ˈɛn ˈaɪ ˈi ɛl/
dialogue.zh: Daniel。拼法是 D-A-N-I-E-L。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And a phone number for the text?
dialogue.phonetic: /ən ə foʊn ˈnʌmbɚ fɚ ðə tɛkst/
dialogue.zh: 還有能收簡訊的電話號碼？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ɪts ˈfɪv faɪv ˈfɪv ˈoʊ wʌn ˈfɔr ˈsɛvən/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Got it. The text comes when you're up.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɑt ɪt ðə tɛkst kʌmz wɛn jʊr ʌp/
dialogue.zh: 記下了。輪到你們時就會傳簡訊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we get a seat by the window?
dialogue.phonetic: /kən wi ɡɛt ə sit baɪ ðə ˈwɪndoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 可以安排在窗邊的位置嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let me see... yes, table six is perfect.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt mi si jɛs ˈteɪbəl sɪks ɪz ˈpɝfɪkt/
dialogue.zh: 我看看……有的，六號桌很完美。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nice! My friend loves morning sun.
dialogue.zh: 太好了！我朋友最喜歡早晨的陽光。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She'll love the menu, too.
dialogue.zh: 她也一定會喜歡我們的菜單。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What should we try here?
dialogue.zh: 我們該點什麼好呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The pancakes, honestly. Everybody orders them.
dialogue.zh: 說真的，鬆餅最棒。人人都點它。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hmm. Does the avocado toast have eggs?
dialogue.phonetic: /hʌm dʊz ðə ˌævəˈkɑdoʊ toʊst həv ɛɡz/
dialogue.zh: 嗯。酪梨吐司裡面有蛋嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two poached, but you can skip them.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu poʧt bʌt ju kæn skɪp ðəm/
dialogue.zh: 有兩顆水波蛋，但你可以請他們不加。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh good, she hates eggs completely.
dialogue.zh: 太好了，她完全不吃蛋。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then we'll tell the kitchen, no problem.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðən wil tɛl ðə ˈkɪtʃɪn noʊ ˈprɑbləm/
dialogue.zh: 那我們就跟廚房說一聲，沒問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Great. Can I buy coffee while we wait?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡreɪt kən aɪ baɪ ˈkɔfi waɪl wi weɪt/
dialogue.zh: 太好了。等待時我能在這裡買杯咖啡嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course! The coffee bar is right there.
dialogue.phonetic: /əv kɔrs ðə ˈkɔfi bɑr ɪz raɪt ðɛr/
dialogue.zh: 當然！咖啡檯就在那邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thanks. Oh, one thing... did you text yet?
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋks oʊ wʌn θɪŋ dɪd ju tɛkst jɛt/
dialogue.zh: 謝謝。喔，對了，你們傳簡訊了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let me check... um, not yet.
dialogue.zh: 我查一下……呃，還沒。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My phone shows nothing new.
dialogue.zh: 我手機上沒有新訊息耶。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hmm. Is that your current number?
dialogue.zh: 嗯。那還是你現在的門號嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait. I moved last month!
dialogue.zh: 等等。我上個月搬家了！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So that's your old number?
dialogue.zh: 所以那是你的舊號碼？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes! I feel so silly.
dialogue.zh: 對啊！我好笨喔。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It happens daily! What's the new one?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ˈhæpənz ˈdeɪli wɑts ðə nu wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 這種事天天都有啦！新的號碼是？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts ˈfɪv faɪv ˈfɪv ˈoʊ wʌn ˈnaɪn ˈnaɪn/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, I'm sending a test text now.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ aɪm ˈsɛndɪŋ ə tɛst tɛkst naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 好，我現在傳一封測試簡訊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One second... oh, it came through!
dialogue.zh: 等一下……喔，收到了！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Phew! You're back on the list.
dialogue.zh: 呼！你們又回到名單上了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thank you so much for fixing that.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋk ju soʊ mʌʧ fɚ ˈfɪksɪŋ ðæt/
dialogue.zh: 真的很謝謝你幫忙處理。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No worries at all, seriously.
dialogue.zh: 別在意，真的常發生。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So, what's the new wait time?
dialogue.zh: 那新的等待時間是多少？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: About twenty minutes more.
dialogue.zh: 大概還要二十分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we wait outside instead?
dialogue.zh: 我們要改到外面等嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's freezing! Stay here by the heater.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts ˈfrizɪŋ steɪ hɪr baɪ ðə ˈhitɚ/
dialogue.zh: 外面超冷的！留在這裡暖氣旁就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good call. Is a bar stool possible?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd kɔl ɪz ə bɑr stul ˈpɑsəbəl/
dialogue.zh: 好提議。吧檯座位也可以嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: For now, yes, take two at the bar.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɚ naʊ jɛs teɪk tu ət ðə bɑr/
dialogue.zh: 現在可以，先去吧台坐兩個位子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And when the text comes?
dialogue.zh: 簡訊來的時候呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Show me the screen, I'll seat you.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃoʊ mi ðə skrin aɪl sit ju/
dialogue.zh: 把手機畫面給我，我就帶你們入座。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Got it. Oh, she just walked in!
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɑt ɪt oʊ ʃi dʒʌst wɔkt ɪn/
dialogue.zh: 知道了。喔，她剛走進來了！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect timing! That's table six opening.
dialogue.zh: 時間剛剛好！六號桌正要空出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are you serious? We're lucky today.
dialogue.zh: 真的假的？我們今天好幸運。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here's your text now, look!
dialogue.zh: 你看，你的簡訊現在就來了！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I see the text! Wow, fast!
dialogue.zh: 我看到簡訊了！哇，好快！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Table six is all yours now.
dialogue.zh: 六號桌現在是你們的了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we carry our coffee over?
dialogue.zh: 我們可以把咖啡帶過去嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, and your server comes right away.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ən jʊr ˈsɜrvɚ kʌmz raɪt əˈweɪ/
dialogue.zh: 可以，服務人員馬上就過來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This was our first brunch here.
dialogue.zh: 這是我們第一次來這裡吃早午餐。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You'll be back, I promise.
dialogue.zh: 你們一定會再來的，我保證。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Definitely. My friend is already smiling.
dialogue.zh: 一定。我朋友已經在笑了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The window seat always works.
dialogue.zh: 靠窗座位從來不失靈。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thank you for all your patience.
dialogue.zh: 謝謝你的耐心幫忙。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Enjoy your brunch, you two!
dialogue.zh: 好好享用你們的早午餐，兩位！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We will. Have a good shift!
dialogue.zh: 我們會的。祝你這班工作順利！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: See you next Sunday!
dialogue.zh: 下星期天見！

script.youtube_description:
60句早午餐候位真實對話，聽完就能自己排名單、留電話、簡訊通知、要靠窗座位！

這一集走進週六早晨的早午餐店門口。一位客人和朋友遲到了，沒有預約，卻在門口人員的幫忙下，學會報名字、留手機、改號碼、問等待時間，最後順利入座六號靠窗桌。

你會練到：
- 排進候位名單：「Can we get on the list?」
- 收簡訊通知：「The text comes when you're up.」
- 開口要靠窗座位：「Can we get a seat by the window?」
- 臨時換號碼：「What's the new one?」

後半段為逐句聽力與跟讀練習，建議先聽兩遍，再一句一句跟著唸出聲。

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用背，多聽就會用。

喜歡這集請訂閱、按讚並開啟小鈴鐺，讓每天一段英文對話成為你的習慣！

script.youtube_description_en:
60 lines of real brunch waitlist English you can hear and use today.

In this episode, a guest with no reservation joins the waitlist at a busy brunch spot. You will hear how to give a name, leave a phone number, fix a wrong number, ask about the wait, and take the window table.

You will practice:
- Asking for a table: Can we get on the list?
- Getting a text: The text comes when you're up.
- Requesting a seat: Can we get a seat by the window?
- Updating your number: What's the new one?

The second half is line-by-line listening and shadowing practice. Listen twice, then repeat every line out loud.

Great for A2 learners: no memorizing needed, just listen and you will start using it.

If you enjoy this lesson, subscribe, like, and turn on notifications for a daily English dialogue!

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish

這一集帶大家走進週六早晨的早午餐店門口，看一位客人如何在門口人員幫忙下排進候位、改手機號碼，最後開心坐進六號靠窗桌。
